summary: Trail runner developed severe altitude illness (HACE, HAPE, and hyponatremia) about 17 hours into a solo-with-partner attempt of the Maroon Bells Four Pass Loop, collapsing unconscious, convulsing and vomiting near 11,000 ft around midnight; a midnight rescue by Mountain Rescue Aspen with Pitkin County deputies and a Flight for Life helicopter airlifted him out; full recovery a year later.
location: Maroon Bells Four Pass Loop (~11,000 ft)
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Flight for Life Colorado
notes: Subject: Wookie Kim; ran from Maroon Bells trailhead at 5:15 a.m. July 10 after arriving from sea level July 8 with minimal acclimation; cause identified as HACE+HAPE+hyponatremia.
